title: Jessica Utts' presidential address on psychic functioning evidence

tellings.quote: she was the you know the president of the American statistical society and stuff one year

plain: A writer and researcher named Eric Wargo told podcast host Jesse Michels about Jessica Utts, a statistician who studied evidence for psychic abilities. He points out that she served one year as president of the American Statistical Association, a major professional body for people who work with data, and in 2016 spoke about that evidence. He mentions it to show that serious scientists have looked at psychic claims and found them worth weighing.
